definition: Mehryar Mohri is a professor and theoretical computer scientist at the Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences.
details: He is also heading the Machine Learning Theory (ML Theory) team at Google Research.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Mehryar Mohri — a small key that opens a big door.
